def pp(frame):
    pts=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:

    return (min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)) if pts else None
print("before:", pp(current_frame))
action(['LEFT'])
print("after LEFT:", pp(current_frame), "changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
lines=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
for r in range(0,64,3):
    row=lines[r]; runs=[]; prev=None; start=0
    for c,ch in enumerate(row+'\n'):
        if ch!=prev:
            if prev is not None: runs.append((prev,start,c-1))
            prev=ch; start=c
    print(r, "".join(f"{col}{a}-{b}" for col,a,b in runs))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
